title: Edison leaves for Millinder; Trombone Smitty's temper
summary: Edison leaves for Lucky Millinder and Big Jim joins; Trombone Smitty, a marijuana smoker with a temper, smashes his trombone and walks out.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
